xmldoc.short_description: Keep only a time window of a record already read.

param_input_item.param_description: the window to keep, from t0 to t1 seconds (or frame indices i to j, one based and inclusive, with 'Frames', true).

param_output_item.param_description: the same struct cut to the window, with its annotations kept and shifted to start at zero.

description.p: Keeps only the window from t0 to t1 seconds of the struct R from wfdb.read: every signal is cut to that span at its own rate, and the annotations in the window are kept and shifted so the cropped record starts at sample one.

The window is measured at the base rate, so all signals are cut at the same instant; a signal recorded faster carries more samples per frame and keeps them all within the kept frames. With 'Frames', true the window is frame indices rather than seconds. A window past the end of a signal cuts it at its own end.
